title: Scholia in Iuvenalem vetustiora — the old scholia on Juvenal; Древние схолии к Ювеналу. Proposed unit: scholia on Satires 1–6
author: Anonymous
edition: Wessner, Teubner 1931 (Wessner d. 1933, so public domain in Russia/EU). Grazzini's edition of the later scholia (recentiora), 2011, is copyrighted
ru_evidence: No translation found; not in the ancientrome.ru catalogue
en_evidence: None found; BMCR 2012.03.42 mentions no translation; R. Pearse's blog offers only ad hoc passages
value: Preserves otherwise lost facts about Flavian Rome (Domitian's council in Sat. 4, incl. a fragment of Statius' De bello Germanico), prosopography, realia and Juvenal's vita. Valuable to social historians and scholars of satire
ai_feasibility: high — short notes; risk in corrupt names and lemmata
pilot_unit: Scholia on Satires 1–6 (est. 25–30k words), or Satires 4 + 6 (est. 12–15k words)
